title: Process Liquor Clarifier
model_title: Multi-Tray Process Liquor Clarifier (Stacked Settling Trays, Common Rake Shaft)

introduction.definition: A multi-tray clarifier stacks several conical settling trays in one tank, each with its own feed, overflow and rake arms on a common shaft. It multiplies settling area to remove fine solids from process liquor in a small footprint.
key_points: Settling depends on area, not depth
introduction.summary: A multi-tray clarifier stacks several conical settling trays in one tank, each with its own feed, overflow and rake. This multiplies settling area to remove fine solids from process liquor in a small footprint.

pressure.title: More settling area in the same footprint
pressure.description: Settling capacity depends on area, not depth. Stacking several trays, each with its own feed, overflow and rake, multiplies the effective settling area in one tank. Fine suspended solids in the process liquor settle on the trays and are raked to the central downcomers; the clarified liquor overflows.

foundation: Large ring foundation or concrete tank; centre pier carries the rake drive and torque.
alignment: Level launders so overflow is even all round; centre the drive and shaft.
piping: Feed to feedwell with flocculant dosing points; underflow pumps with standby and flushing; overflow to downstream.
commissioning: Fill with water, run rakes and test torque alarms and lift; start feed and flocculant; build mud bed gradually.

lubrication: Agitator gearbox oil and motor bearings per maker; no lubrication for static parts.

video_tutorials.title: Process Liquor Clarifier — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Process Liquor Clarifier.
A multi-tray clarifier stacks several conical settling trays in one tank, each with its own feed, overflow and rake arms on a common shaft.
It multiplies settling area to remove fine solids from process liquor in a small footprint.
Typical applications include liquor clarification; green-liquor/process liquor polishing.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Rake Arms on the Common Shaft (one set per tray).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Process Liquor Clarifier — Operation

script.narration: How the Process Liquor Clarifier works.
Feed enters each tray.
Solids settle on the trays.
Rakes push solids to downcomers.
Clear liquor overflows.
Solids leave from the bottom.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Settling capacity depends on area, not depth.

video_tutorials.title: Process Liquor Clarifier — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Process Liquor Clarifier.
Check overflow clarity per tray.
Torque trend.
Inspect trays and rakes.
Watch for tray overload: solids carry-over. Common cause: uneven feed split.
Watch for rake torque: trip. Common cause: build-up.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
